name: arXiv Today
author: Synapse
description: Each morning, the papers announced on arXiv in your categories, ranked by how well they match you: the specific papers of your library they cite, the references they share with it, shared authors and topics. Earlier days stay for a month, and AI apps can ask for them too.

settings.label: Categories
settings.description: Add one arXiv category or archive per row: quant-ph, cond-mat.str-el, hep-th, cs.LG …

settings.label: Your author names
settings.description: Names you publish under, in Given Family order, one alias per row. Papers citing your own library papers get the Cites you badge and a strong boost. Full first names are matched when both sides have them; with initials only, namesakes can match.

settings.label: Followed authors
settings.description: People whose papers get a Following badge in the feed. Enter full names in Given Family order, one name per row. Matching ignores case, accents and extra spaces; add each published name variant separately. This does not change scores.

settings.label: Include cross-lists
settings.description: Papers from other categories that are also listed in yours.

settings.label: Read reference lists
settings.description: From each paper’s HTML version on arXiv, to see which papers in your library it cites (one request every 3 seconds, in the background).

settings.label: Read from match
settings.description: Papers with a match (0–100) from this value are in the Read tier, counted first in the morning notification.

settings.label: Skim from match
settings.description: Papers with a match from this value (and under Read) are in the Skim tier; the rest come last.

settings.label: Learn from what I do
settings.description: Each night, adjust how much each kind of evidence counts from the papers you add, open, dismiss or pass over (listed above one you opened). Days you never opened teach nothing.

settings.label: Tell me when new papers arrive
Keep for
settings.description: Days after which a listing is forgotten (papers you added stay in your library).
